about: Hockey's defaults, as data (docs/PLAN-start-a-game-gpt.md track L, L1): a sport's standard scoring, categories, lineup slots and locks, and the game specs a sport's Make it a game starts from instead of asking the bot. Stat keys are Hockey's (src/lib/sports/hockey.ts): skaters' and goalies' in one table, since a key is unique in the sport (a skater scores goals, G; a goalie allows them, GA). Slots take its positions or position groups. The specs are in the game spec's shape (A1's schema, on the engine branch); slots and categories aren't in that schema yet (L4 adds them), so they're kept beside it for the spec to read.
finalSource: Step 2.7 (docs/PLAN-sports-ready.md): the final a game through the playoffs runs to, as people name it ("Through the Super Bowl"); words for 4.0's pass

scoring.source: Yahoo's default head-to-head points (help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6815.html): skaters, then goalies

categories.source: Yahoo's standard 10 categories (rotisserie and head-to-head categories): six for skaters, four for goalies

ir.source: Yahoo's default roster's 2 IR, outside its 16, for someone on the NHL's injured reserve only (its IR+, which takes DTD and O too, isn't in the default) (help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6815.html, SLN6425.html, 2026-11-20)

waivers.source: Yahoo's public defaults: a continual rolling list, roster changes Daily - Today, at most 4 acquisitions a week (help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN6815.html, 2026-11-20). Claims clear each game day's morning, 12 hours before its first game, then free agents until its last game starts (BACKLOG 219; docs/PLAN-sports-ready.md step 2.5)

pace.source: The user's rule (2026-11-19, BACKLOG 218): a seat at its own pace is never more than one game behind; when the next game starts, the one before counts as watched (docs/PLAN-sports-ready.md step 2.6)

season.about: A season-long league: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head each week.

short.about: One game, a series or a team's next few: everyone drafts a few players, every one of them scores, most points wins.

pickem.about: Each game, before it starts: who wins? A point for each one right, most points wins (a tie counts for nobody).

pickAFew.about: Each game, before it starts: pick three players. 3 points for each one who has the most points (goals and assists) in the game (tied, each of them), most points wins.

ask.ask: Pick three: who has the most points (goals and assists)?

categories.about: A season-long league by categories: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup, play someone head to head in Yahoo's ten categories: each category you win is a win.

roto.about: A season-long league, roto-style: draft a full roster, set a daily lineup; each of Yahoo's ten categories ranks everyone over the season, points by rank, most points wins.

bestBall.about: Best ball: draft a full roster and never set a lineup: each game, your best twelve count, most points wins.

bracket.about: A playoff bracket: before the NHL playoffs start, pick who wins every series, round by round to the Stanley Cup Final. A point for each one right in the first round, doubling each round after it; most points wins.

ask.ask: Who wins every series of the NHL playoffs?
